# Andrew Tischler

> Professional oil painting instruction and tutorials from Andrew Tischler, a 20-year veteran artist offering comprehensive courses in landscape, portrait, and plein air techniques.

Andrew Tischler's platform features an extensive collection of painting tutorials, online academy courses, and exclusive art experiences. The site serves both beginners and advanced artists seeking to develop their skills in oil painting, landscape composition, and portrait techniques through structured courses and free resources.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://andrewtischler.com): Andrew Tischler's homepage showcasing tutorials, academy, and art instruction.
- [About Andrew Tischler](https://andrewtischler.com/about): Biography of Andrew Tischler, professional artist with 20 years experience.
- [Contact Us](https://andrewtischler.com/contact-us): Contact form and newsletter signup to connect with Andrew Tischler.

## Painting Courses & Tutorials

- [Store](https://andrewtischler.com/store): Online store selling painting tutorials including Pine Tree and portrait courses.
- [Shop](https://andrewtischler.com/shop): Shop page offering painting courses and tutorials on landscape and portrait art.
- [How to Paint Trees](https://andrewtischler.com/trees): Comprehensive 50+ hour tree painting course from beginner to advanced level.
- [Free Pine Tree Tutorial](https://andrewtischler.com/free): Free 1.5-hour oil painting tutorial covering brush techniques and color mixing.

## Experiences & Events

- [Art Tour 2026](https://andrewtischler.com/art-tour-2026): Exclusive 2026 New Zealand plein air painting tour with Andrew Tischler.

## Blog & Resources

- [Blog](https://andrewtischler.com/blog): Blog featuring oil painting techniques, studio setup, and skill-building exercises.
